about: Records added after the November 2026 cost-library audit. Every figure was read from the official source on the date shown: the Canim Lake memo's Appendix B tables from the PDF text, and the Payne Road award and bids from the City of Chilliwack bid page. Sources the review could not read in full stay under pending, with no amounts.

records.title: Payne Road culvert replacement (Elkview Creek)
records.party: Rick Weigelmann Rock Trucks and Excavating Ltd.
records.place: Payne Road at Elkview Creek, Chilliwack
records.sample: 10 bids, from $196,350.00 to $498,444.50; the second-lowest was $210,274.08
records.scope: Supply all labour, materials and equipment for the Payne Road culvert replacement: primarily culvert replacement, road widening and stream flow management.
cautions: An award at bid; no quantities, unit prices or final cost are published.
The bid page does not say whether the amounts include GST.
The bids span 2.5 times the lowest: read one award as one contractor's price, not the cost of the work.
records.locator: Closed bids, 2025-05 Payne Road Culvert Replacement
